description: Use this when someone asks for drill results (assays, drill holes, intercepts) from listed mining companies: the latest across the market, for one metal, or from one company. Give it a metal (gold, copper, Au, Cu…), a company's ticker or name, both, or nothing. Returns drill news releases newest first, each with its date, company, project as the company names it and 6ix.com link, and each hole's result copied as the release printed it (grade over length, from depth), the company's headline holes first; pass the answer's nextCursor as cursor for earlier ones.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

metal.description: A metal's name or symbol: gold, silver, copper, Au, Ag, Cu, U3O8…

name: get_drill_results

hasMore.description: More follow: ask again with cursor set to nextCursor

listChanged.description: The list changed since the cursor was made and the last item shown is no longer in it, so an item may repeat or be missed here

metal.description: The metal's symbol the releases were narrowed to

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read on from the last item shown; null at the end

holes.description: The company's headline holes first, then the rest in hole order

headline.description: The company's own headline names this hole

lengthUnit.description: Metres or feet, as the release prints them

metal.description: The metal's symbol as the release prints it (Au, Cu, U3O8…)

result.description: The hole's result in words, e.g. QV26-025 2.73 g/t Au over 21.75 m from 259.25 m

unit.description: The grade's unit as printed (g/t, %, ppm…)

project.description: The project as the company names it

title: Drill results
